# Share Conversation as Image

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns selected conversation messages into a PNG
card you can download

k Harness plugin that turns selected conversation messages into a PNG
card you can download or copy.

- Pick exactly which messages go into the image.
- One click on any assistant reply starts from that

reply plus the question
before it.
- Rendered locally with Canvas as a clean reading card: a compac

t brand
header, right-aligned user bubbles, assistant answers with code blocks,
lists, and quotes, p

lus a footer that repeats the brand rule and the capture
details.
- Download as PNG or copy straight

to the clipboard. Nothing leaves the
browser.

`conversation-share-image` bundle row a

nd action/overlay IDs stay unchanged.

load both names together. The former npm package is retained for migration.

## Usage

Every finalized assistant reply has a picture action beside Copy and Branch.
Clicking it opens the m

essage picker with that answer and the question before
it already checked.

In the picker, tick the messages to include — **Select all** picks the whole
conversation — then cho

ose **Create image**. The preview offers **Download
PNG** and **Copy image**, plus **Back to selecti
on** to change the set.

The card contains the selected messages: your messages sit in DeepSeek-blue
bubbles on the right, as

sistant answers run as plain text on the left, and a
header and footer carry the brand and the captu

re details. Reasoning, tool
calls, command rows, and system context are left out so the image reads

like a
transcript rather than a log.
## Notes and limits

- Only content already loaded in the current view can be selected. If older
turns have not been page

d in yet, the picker says so.
- Consecutive assistant steps are shown as one row in the picker and m

erged
into one answer in the image; unselected messages in between are skipped.
- A very long conver

sation is truncated to fit one image; the card then ends
with a note saying the most recent messages

were kept.
- The card is laid out at phone width (390 logical px) and exported at up to
3x, so it f

ills a phone screen with readable text wherever it is shared.
- The card keeps a fixed light palette

, independent of the active UI theme.
- The PNG is generated locally in the browser. Nothing is uplo

ependent of the active UI theme.
- The PNG is generated locally in the browser. Nothing is uploaded.
## How it is put together

- `index.js` — Host half, intentionally empty; the bundle only mounts.
- `client.js` — the whole cli

ent plugin: Canvas renderer, picker, preview
overlay, locale dictionaries, and slot registrations.
-

`cordis.patch.yml` — the bundle patch that inserts the plugin row.
- `locale/en.json`, `locale/zh.j
son` — message catalogs for the plugin store.
The plugin registers two slots:

- `conversation.chat.assistant-actions` — the picture action on each finalized
assistant message.
-
`shell.overlay` — the message picker and image preview modal.

No options. The bundle is entirely browser-side; the Host half exists only to
mount the bundle in th

. The bundle is entirely browser-side; the Host half exists only to
mount the bundle in the profile.
